summary: Test-writing-only run for issue #5. Added characterization/contract tests in iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/APIClientTests.swift against the hand-written APIClient, using the real color_matching OpenAPI contract (read from viamin/color_matching @ 05062f5381a6f76413cc2bdf1cb2cc08a1b70ff7, which closed viamin/color_matching#110) instead of the stale prose doc. No swift-openapi-generator dependency, vendored spec, generated client, or APIClient/model changes were made (out of scope for this TDD-boundary test-writing run). Two of the new tests fail against the current implementation, documenting real contract drift (required-but-omitted normalized_linear_rgb_median key; undocumented scoring_algorithm_version/stats fields); two add missing coverage for fetchManifest/fetchRecentSheets. No Swift toolchain is available in this sandbox, so `swift test` could not be executed to confirm red/green status directly -- correctness was verified by manual code reading against the real Elixir schema/controller/view source and against existing passing-test patterns in the same file.
